business_summary.text: Dishman Carbogen Amcis is a global pharmaceutical CDMO with operations in India, Europe, and the US, providing drug substance and drug product development and manufacturing services.

call_points.text: Management expects 15% CAGR revenue growth over next 3 years
No major CapEx plans except Japanese co-investment; maintenance CapEx only

guidance.statement: 15% CAGR revenue growth over next 3 years
India business revenue target of ₹500 Cr by FY28

operating_notes.text: ADC business contributed 25% of CDMO revenue in FY26
France facility revenue of €8M with EBITDA loss of €9M in FY26; target €11-12M revenue and €6M loss in FY27
Swiss entity tech transfer to India expected to increase group margins by 20-25%
ADC revenue at ₹150 Cr in Q1FY27, including linker, payload, and hypermolecule
One molecule recently commercialized, two new molecules entered late Phase III
Tech transfer of one project from Switzerland to India in progress, to be completed within current financial year

holders.name: Hsbc Mutual Fund - Hsbc Flexi Cap Fund

timeline.summary: Dishman Carbogen Amcis held Q1FY27 earnings call on August 17, 2026, reporting revenue of ₹677.64 Cr, PAT loss of ₹57.88 Cr, and announcing new Global CCO Angela Ameriks and promoter ECB plan of up to CHF 200 million.

upcoming_events.description: Board meeting to discuss promoter ECB

watchlist.text: Regulatory and shareholder approval for promoter ECB

watchlist.response: Depreciation has remained constant in functional currency; increase due to foreign currency fluctuation when converted to INR
watchlist.text: Depreciation cost increasing sequentially every quarter

watchlist.response: Tax rate elevated due to losses in subsidiaries; expected to normalize to 40% in FY27 and 30% in FY28
watchlist.text: Elevated tax rate of 50% in Q4FY26

watchlist.response: Interest cost will reduce to ₹30-35 Cr/quarter from Q2FY27 after refinancing high-cost India debt with 4% ECB
watchlist.text: Interest cost not reducing as expected

watchlist.response: Business is inherently lumpy, best viewed on a 2-3 year perspective; fixed costs mean revenue growth directly translates to EBITDA
watchlist.text: Lumpy quarterly earnings due to B2B nature and development work cycles
